svg.title: Proof. The eigenvalues of T λ are 1, −r/2, −r/2. Hence Cλ has ordinary rank nine, and its second and fifth singular values are both r/2. A PSD factorization of size d has ordinary rank at most d2, excluding d ≤2. Suppose a size-three factorization exists.
